reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis that thermally activated diffusion and lattice distortions drive phase stability in high-entropy alloys is broadly supported by known foundational science, though it is somewhat general.
reasons.testability: It can be evaluated by comparing microstructures and properties before and after heat treatments at specified temperatures, although the property to be measured and quantitative criteria for falsification are only loosely defined.
reasons.usefulness: It offers a plausible pathway to investigate the causes of phase changes in these alloys, but the hypothesis and proposed test are at a fairly general level and would benefit from more specific details.
